entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane where natural mages are rare and devices fueled by aether do the work of magic; later renamed Avishkar.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker born on Kaladesh who returns and saves her mother from her nemesis Baral.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A scheming planeswalker who confronts the Gatewatch on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that unexpectedly confronts Tezzeret on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government that rules Kaladesh, whose forces and works are nearly omnipresent.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: Magical energy that fuels automatons, thopters and other artifact creatures on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker featured on Kaladesh boosters.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker featured on Kaladesh boosters.
